description_en: Rebuilds an instance from the recycle bin
description_zh: 该接口用于重建已进入回收站的实例
kebab_example: aliyun rds create-db-instance-for-rebuild --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --db-instance-id rm-uf6wjk50000 --pay-type Postpaid --region cn-hangzhou
name: CreateDBInstanceForRebuild

parameters.help_en: The region ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/610399.html operation to query the most recent region list
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en: The instance ID. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/610396.html operation to query the ID of the instance
parameters.name: db_instance_id

parameters.help_en:
The billing method of the destination instance. Valid values:

Postpaid: pay-as-you-go
Prepaid: subscription
parameters.help_zh:
目标实例的付费类型，取值：
Postpaid：后付费（按量付费）
Prepaid：预付费（包年包月）
parameters.name: pay_type

parameters.help_en:
The IP address whitelist of the serverless instance. For more information, see https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/43185.html. If the IP address whitelist contains more than one entry, separate the entries with commas (,). Each entry must be unique. You can specify up to 1,000 entries. The entries in the IP address whitelist must be in one of the following formats:

IP addresses, such as 10.10.XX.XX.
CIDR blocks, such as 10.10.XX.XX/24. In this example, 24 indicates that the prefix of each IP address in the IP address whitelist is 24 bits in length. You can replace 24 with a value within the range of 1 to 32.

If this parameter is not specified, the default IP address whitelist is used
parameters.help_zh:
该实例的https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/43185.html。多条记录请以半角逗号（,）隔开，不可重复，最多1000条记录。支持如下两种格式：
IP地址形式，例如：10.10.XX.XX。
CIDR形式，例如：10.10.XX.XX/24（无类域间路由，24表示了地址中前缀的长度，范围为1~32）。

如不填则默认为原实例default分组白名单信息
parameters.name: security_ip_list

parameters.help_en:
The name of the instance. The name must be 2 to 256 characters in length. The name can contain letters, digits, underscores (_), and hyphens (-). The name must start with a letter.

: The name cannot start with http:// or https://
parameters.help_zh:
目标实例名称，长度为2~256个字符。以中文、英文字母开头，可以包含数字、中文、英文、下划线（_）、短横线（-）。
不能以 http:// 和 https:// 开头
parameters.name: db_instance_description

parameters.help_en:
The zone ID of the primary instance. You can call the https://help.aliyun.com/document_detail/26243.html operation to query the most recent zone list.

If you specify a virtual private cloud (VPC) and a vSwitch, you must specify this parameter to identify the zone for the vSwitch
parameters.help_zh:
主节点可用区ID。可以通过接口DescribeRegions查看可用区ID。

指定了VPC和交换机时，为匹配交换机对应的可用区，该参数必填
parameters.name: zone_id

parameters.help_en:
The zone ID of the secondary instance.

If the instance does not run RDS Basic Edition, you must specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
备可用区1。
非基础系列实例需要传入该参数
parameters.name: zone_id_slave_1

parameters.help_en:
The zone ID of the logger instance.

This parameter is available only when the instance runs RDS Enterprise Edition
parameters.help_zh:
备可用区2。
仅三节点企业系列实例可传入该参数
parameters.name: zone_id_slave_2

parameters.help_en:
The VPC ID of the instance. If you set InstanceNetworkType to VPC, you must specify this parameter.

: If you specify this parameter, you must also specify ZoneId
parameters.help_zh:
目标实例的VPC ID。当InstanceNetworkType=VPC时，本参数必须配置。
如果传入此参数，您还需要传入参数ZoneId
parameters.name: vpc_id

parameters.help_en:
The ID of the vSwitch. The vSwitch must belong to the zone that is specified by ZoneId.



If you set InstanceNetworkType to VPC, you must also specify this parameter.

If you specify the ZoneSlaveId1 parameter, you must specify the IDs of two vSwitches for this parameter and separate the IDs with a comma (,)
parameters.help_zh:
虚拟交换机ID。虚拟交换机所在的可用区必须和ZoneId中传入的可用区ID相对应。

网络类型InstanceNetworkType需为VPC。
若您填写了ZoneSlaveId1（备可用区ID），此处需填写两个交换机ID，并使用半角逗号（,）隔开
parameters.name: vswitch_id

parameters.help_en:
The unit of the subscription duration. Valid values:

Year
Month

If you set the PayType parameter to Prepaid, you must also specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定预付费实例为包年或者包月类型，取值：
Year：包年。
Month：包月。

若付费类型为Prepaid则该参数必须传入
parameters.name: period

parameters.help_en:
The subscription duration of the instance. Valid values:

If you set Period to Year, the value of UsedTime ranges from 1 to 5.
If you set Period to Month, the value of UsedTime ranges from 1 to 11.

If you set PayType to Prepaid, you must specify this parameter
parameters.help_zh:
指定购买时长。取值：
当参数Period为Year时，UsedTime取值为1~5。
当参数Period为Month时，UsedTime取值为1~11。

若PayType为Prepaid，需要传入该参数
parameters.name: used_time

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request. You can use the client to generate the token, but you must make sure that the token is unique among different requests.

The token can contain only ASCII characters and cannot exceed 64 characters in length
parameters.help_zh:
该参数用于保证请求的幂等性，防止重复提交请求。参数值由客户端生成，保证在不同请求间唯一。

该参数值由ASCII字符组成，最长不超过64个字符，不能包含非ASCII字符
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en:
The type of the network connection to the instance. Valid values:

Internet
Intranet
parameters.help_zh:
实例的网络连接类型，取值：
Internet：公网连接。
Intranet：内网连接
parameters.name: db_instance_net_type

parameters.help_en:
The network type of the instance. Valid values:

VPC
Classic

Default value: Classic.

If the instance uses cloud disks, this parameter is required. Set the value to VPC. The VpcId and VSwitchId parameters must be specified when this parameter is set to VPC
parameters.help_zh:
目标实例的网络类型，取值：

VPC：VPC网络
Classic：经典网络

默认创建经典网络类型的实例。
当实例为云盘实例时，该参数必填，且值为VPC。当本参数值为VPC时，还需要传入参数VpcId、VSwitchId
parameters.name: instance_network_type

parameters.help_en: The ID of the resource group. The value of this parameter can be NULL
parameters.name: resource_group_id
